svg.title: Складка с фитболом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Swiss-ball pike in true side view. Both arms straight, palms on floor at same location in both phases. ONE large round Swiss ball supports lower shins and ankles. LEFT high plank straight from shoulders to ankles, shins on ball with hips level. RIGHT same athlete rolls ball closer under feet and lifts hips high into clear inverted V, chest toward thighs and knees almost straight. Only shins or feet remain supported on top of ball, never hands. Show a clear difference from a knee tuck, no kneeling and no ball exchange. Same facing direction and same ball scale in both halves. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
